bone.$description: Bone — Primary canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark bands — the dominant air of the system

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

vault-ink.$description: Vault Ink — Primary heading text, dark band backgrounds, footer surface — the near-black that carries all authority and seals dark chambers

absolute.$description: Absolute — Deepest dark band background, high-contrast text on light surfaces — used where absolute weight is required

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary dark surface, border on dark sections — one shade lighter than Absolute for layered darkness

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark border, secondary text on dark surfaces, image overlay tones

silver-veil.$description: Silver Veil — Muted card text, disabled states, secondary metadata — the quietest readable neutral

frost.$description: Frost — Decorative border, link accent on dark, subtle cool-tinted hairline — the only chromatic whisper in the neutral stack

cobalt-signal.$description: Cobalt Signal — Gradient origin — small icon accents, arrow markers, chromatic punctuation on otherwise monochrome controls

electric-sky.$description: Electric Sky — Gradient terminus — the bright terminal of the blue mark, always paired with Cobalt Signal as a gradient pair

interdisplay.$description: Primary workhorse — body copy, UI controls, nav, and most headings. Carries the system's voice at 400 weight only; variation comes from size and tracking, not weight. Single-weight usage is a signature choice: the system never bolds, only scales.

roobert.$description: Display and feature headings, hero typography, emphasis text. Used at the top of the hierarchy where 90–96px sizes demand a typeface with more open counters and personality. Also appears in nav and inputs for tactile warmth against Interdisplay's neutrality.

inter-24-pt.$description: Secondary body, card copy, link text, image captions — a quieter Inter variant for less prominent content areas where Interdisplay would feel too dominant

fragmentmono.$description: Monospaced accent for nav labels, link IDs, technical metadata, heading eyebrows — a typewriter whisper that signals precision and protocol

aeonik-mono.$description: Rare monospaced flourish for signature inline moments — used as the tiniest typographic exclamation in the system
